question: Who among the following has been awarded with the 2020 Richard Dawkins Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Javed Akhtar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Center for Inquiry bestows the Richard Dawkins Award every year**.
 
• The **Atheist Alliance **of **America **in **collaboration **with **Richard Dawkins **and the **Richard Dawkins Foundation **for **Reasearch and Science first presented it in 2003**.
 
• In **2019**, the **award was formally moved to CFI**.
 
• **Javed Akhtar **has been **awarded **with the **2020 Richard Dawkins Award**.
 
• **Javed Akhtar**:
 
 
• **Indian poet**, **lyricist**, **screenwriter**, and **political activist Javed Akhtar**.
 
• He is **well-known **for his **work **in **Hindi film **and has **awarded the Padma Shri **in **1999 **and the **Padma Bhushan in 2007**, two of India's highest civilian honours.
 
• He has **also won five National Film Awards**.
 
• He was **born on 17 January 1945**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Irrfan Khan**, also known simply as Irrfan, was an **Indian actor **who worked in **Indian cinema **as well as **British and American films**.
 
• **Indian actor**, **producer**, **host**, **occasional playback vocalist**, and **former politician Amitabh Bachchan **is well recognised for his work in **Hindi cinema**. He is regarded as **one of the most significant actors **in Indian cinematic history.
 
• **Indian actress Deepika Padukone **performs in Hindi-language movies. She is one of India's highest-paid actresses and has won three Filmfare Awards, among other honours.
